changes.details: Full-screen dark overlay with progress bar, status text, and changelog. Matches the MonoUI menu style.

changes.summary: Refactored into a lightweight PlaceId router.
changes.details: It detects the current place (with UniverseId fallback) and only loads the matching game's script; unsupported places are handled cleanly.
Every game's features now live in their own standalone script instead of one long unified loader.

changes.title: Toggle
changes.details: The menu toggle is now fixed in the bottom-left corner and can no longer be dragged.

changes.title: Open / Close animations
changes.details: Smooth, consistent grow-from-toggle and shrink-back animations across every game script.

changes.title: Home
changes.details: Three premium plan cards (7 Days $2.50 / 30 Days $6.00 / Lifetime $14.00) with colored backgrounds (blue, purple, gold), checkmark feature lists, and "Visit our website to buy" footers. Free vs Premium comparison and Join Discord footer included.

changes.title: Settings
changes.details: Debug Mode toggle, Auto-Load Config on Start toggle, Show Notifications toggle, Notification Duration slider (1–15s), and Reset All Settings button.
Unsupported places now load `game/universal.lua` with Player ESP, walk speed, jump power, infinite jump, anti-AFK, and the shared Fly / No-clip / Target Fling tools.

changes.title: Clean the WORLD!
changes.details: Game taken down; module and all references removed.
